stills.prompt: A vast circular chamber built entirely from the stone shown in @stone: polished black stone with fine natural veins of antique gold, the veins catching light. Low camera on the floor looking toward the far wall. High in the domed ceiling a small round opening glows warm amber, no sky visible; one narrow shaft of warm gold light falls through drifting dust onto the floor, where the emblem from @stone is inlaid in worn gold, flush with the stone. In the far wall, between two columns, an arched dark wooden door stands slightly ajar with warm amber light in the gap. Beside the door on a low stone platform: a plain wooden chair with a charcoal coat draped over its back, and a dark stoneware cup. Everything outside the beam and the door gap falls to near-black. No daylight, no white or blue light, no grey stone, no people, no lettering. Restrained, photorealistic, natural film grain.
